title: AutoNEAR product demo

segments.text: The vault holds the agent's budget on NEAR: half a NEAR per action, two a day, ten in total, and an expiry date.
segments.style: Brisk and crisp, each limit its own beat.

segments.text: The blockchain enforces those limits, not our server.
segments.style: Firm, level, proud.

segments.text: Go outside them, and the transaction is refused.
segments.style: Flat and decisive on 'refused'.
